hero.lede: Lab²Launch translates your science into investor-ready language and gives you a structured gap analysis on what's missing — across people, process, evidence, and execution.

problem.label: The problem
problem.titleEm: But you can't write the deck.
problem.description: Most deep-tech founders are exceptional scientists but inexperienced presenters. The investor pitch is usually a translation problem - they can sense your amazing research, but can't understand why to invest. And every accelerator program punishes you for it.

cells.title: What investors hear
cells.quote: This is your interesting science, and here is how it works in detail - but I don't understand what problem you're solving?.

cells.title: What founders feel
cells.quote: I've spent six years on this and I'm the first to do it. Why is the panel asking about the real-world problem it solves and TAM?

threeActs.label: How it works
threeActs.description: Lab²Launch runs your inputs through BA frameworks — POPIT, SWOT, Stakeholder Analysis — and surfaces the gaps investors will find before it's too late.

acts.title: Just a few questions
acts.body: You answer the questions every investor will ask, and will then respond to follow up questions.

bullets.text: What is your route to market?
What does your team bring that others cannot replicate?
What evidence exists that customers will pay?
What risks have you not yet named?

acts.title: Claude scores the gaps
acts.body: Our Claude-powered analysis engine scores your readiness across five dimensions. It identifies your strongest assets and names the specific gaps investors will press on.

bullets.text: Problem clarity · Is the pain economic or safety-critical?
Market evidence · Bottom-up TAM with customer discovery
Competitive position · Genuine moat vs feature parity
Team & execution · Right skills, governance, advisors
Risk awareness · Sector-specific risks named and mitigated

acts.title: Three sequenced actions
acts.body: You leave with a prioritised action list. Not generic advice, but specific, testable steps ranked by investor impact, with a first action for this week.

bullets.text: Competitive mapping: file the landscape before the pitch
Governance: confirm IP assignment before the term sheet

liveReport.label: Sample report
liveReport.title: Lab²Launch · NovaCore

stages.title: Plain English summary
stages.description: A one-paragraph summary written for your neighbour or parents — no jargon, no acronyms.

stages.title: Your strongest assets
stages.description: Three to five specific, defensible things your project has that matter to investors. Patent status, clinical data, regulatory designation, anchor customer.

stages.title: Five-dimension gap analysis
stages.description: Scored /10 across Problem Clarity, Market Evidence, Competitive Position, Team & Execution, Risk Awareness. Each score comes with now/target/gap bullets.

stages.title: Top 3 sequenced actions
stages.description: Ranked by investor impact. Each action has a deliverable, a timeline, and a specific first step for this week — no vague advice.

actions.text: Run 10 customer discovery calls in 3 weeks
Build bottom-up TAM from hospital procurement data
Name a commercial co-founder or fractional CCO

liveReport.plainEnglish: NovaCore has developed a bioscaffold material that helps bone heal faster after surgery. The science is strong — two published papers, a UK provisional patent, and early data from a sheep model. The gap is commercial: there is no clear buyer story, no evidence of what hospitals would pay, and the team has no one who has sold into an NHS procurement pathway before.

popit.label: The methodology
popit.description: POPIT (People, Organisation, Process, Information, Technology) is the BA standard for change readiness. We run it invisibly inside every analysis.

dimensions.name: People
dimensions.description: Skills, knowledge, roles, culture, and the human capacity to execute on the commercial plan.

dimensions.name: Organisation
dimensions.description: Structure, governance, legal entities, IP ownership, and the organisational readiness for investment.

dimensions.name: Process
dimensions.description: Go-to-market routes, regulatory pathways, sales processes, and operational scalability.

dimensions.name: Information
dimensions.description: Market data, customer evidence, competitive intelligence, and the factual basis for claims made to investors.

dimensions.name: Technology
dimensions.description: IP position, technical differentiation, defensibility, and the link between science and commercial value.
